items.content: Value topology across the programme: representation-optimization lanes all collapsed onto donors (R6I strict 0/10 both subjects; R6K collapses onto R6J everywhere; R6M C=R6L on all 30 matchings; receipts MAX_R6I/K/M_*_RESULTS.json), while typed partial-knowledge epistemic state produced the positives: N4 all six families supported (typed VOI, scoped reopening, interval-targeted verification, chain laundering detection recall 1.0/FPR 0, decision-coupled probing, typed remint transport), N3 all four residual-confirmed, N2-F5B mixed with only a misspecification-robustness edge surviving the donor. The gap that remains in the R6 family is not an optimization gap but a characterization gap: nobody can yet decide from a target batch alone which regime it falls in.
